column3: A pending code install carries the registry's dist.integrity, served by /v1/build/packages, and plugin sync refuses a lockfile that resolves the spec to another SRI
column4: consent covers the package.json the market read; without a pin the build could install other bytes under the same version range or a republished tag; bun.lock already records the SRI, so the check is a lockfile read with no network
column5: test/lockfile.test.ts accepts the consented SRI and refuses another or a non-registry resolution; market.test.ts shows the SRI in the pending list
